object.attr: as implemented: lets a shortcut or a script open one repository directly, as in `mellon.exe C:\work\project-reqs` (INSTALL.md, First launch). Which folders are refused, and what the refusal says, is MELLON-STORE-SRS-5 to -12.
object.description: When the GUI starts with a folder path as the argument, the GUI shall open the folder as the repository.
